KING GEORGE'S MEDICAL UNIVERSITY
Office of the Dean
King George's Medical University (KGMU) publishes its prospectus annually.
The institution, also known as King George Medical College, was established in the city.
Formerly known as King George Medical College and Hospital, it admits students annually.
Devanagari name: किंग जॉर्ज मेडिकल यूनिवर्सिटी
